identificationModule.briefTitle: Phase III Trial of SYS6010 Versus Platinum-based Chemotherapy for EGFR-mutated NSCLC（SYNSTAR01）
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Open-label, Multi-center, Phase III Clinical Study Comparing SYS6010 With Platinum-based Chemotherapy in the Treatment of EGFR-mutated Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-small Cell Lung Cancer After Failure of EGFR TKI Treatment

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of SYS6010 versus platinum-based chemotherapy in participants with EGFR-mutated locally advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)
descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
This is a randomized, open-label, multi-center, phase III clinical study, aiming to evaluate the efficacy and safety of SYS6010 versus platinum-based chemotherapy in participants with EGFR-mutated locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC who have failed EGFR TKI therapy.

This study implemented a hierarchical testing strategy to control the overall Type I error at a one-sided alpha level of 0.025. If the null hypothesis for PFS was rejected, the full alpha (0.025) was recycled for OS analysis.

conditions: EGFR-mutated Locally Advanced or Metastatic NSCLC

designInfo.interventionModelDescription: SYS6010,Q3W This is a randomized, open-label, multi-center, phase III clinical study, aiming to evaluate the efficacy and safety of SYS6010 versus platinum-based chemotherapy in participants with EGFR-mutated locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC who have failed EGFR TKI therapy. Approximately 380 participants are planned to be enrolled, who will be randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to the experimental group: SYS6010, and the control group: pemetrexed + cisplatin/carboplatin. Randomization stratification factors include: presence of brain metastasis (yes or no), received third-generation EGFR TKI treatment before (yes or no)
